python3 << 'EOF'
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill

wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

# Copy header style from an existing header cell
hdr = ws['A1']
new_hdr = ws['H1']
new_hdr.value = 'Profit Margin'
new_hdr.font = Font(bold=True)
new_hdr.fill = PatternFill(start_color='00CCE5FF', end_color='00CCE5FF', fill_type='solid')

# Per-row profit margin = Profit / Revenue, formatted as percentage
for r in range(2, 10):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=8, value=f'=G{r}/E{r}')
    c.number_format = '0.0%'

# Total row: overall profit margin = total profit / total revenue
c = ws['H10']
c.value = '=G10/E10'
c.number_format = '0.0%'

# Match column width of sibling columns
ws.column_dimensions['H'].width = ws.column_dimensions['G'].width

wb.save('sales_data.xlsx')
print('Saved. H1:', ws['H1'].value, '| H2:', ws['H2'].value, '| H10:', ws['H10'].value)
EOF
